title: Sety II’s triple bark shrine
summary: The shrine predates the court that later enclosed it.
orientation: In the Great Court; its entrance faces south.
architecture: Three chambers accommodated the sacred barks of Mut, Amun and Khonsu.

claims.text: In the Great Court; its entrance faces south.
The shrine predates the court that later enclosed it. Three chambers accommodated the sacred barks of Mut, Amun and Khonsu.
The chambers are assigned west to Mut, centre to Amun and east to Khonsu.
A role in popular worship is proposed; it does not establish unrestricted public access throughout the temple.

caveats: Present access, exact viewpoints and condition have not been field-verified.
